shared_elements: frontal standing/seated human figure carved in stone relief
prominent head with headdress or cap at top of the figure
arms brought toward the chest holding or clasping something
circular/oval boss or disc-like motif on the torso area
subsidiary carved motifs flanking the central figure
worn, pitted stone surface with shallow incised detail
justification: Both centre a frontal human figure on a vertical axis, headdressed above, arms drawn to the chest, with smaller flanking carved motifs at either side, which is a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The manner differs sharply, however: A is a massive dark boulder-monument with shallow incised curvilinear motifs and a banded lower register, while B is a pale, flat slab whose figure stands out in blocky high relief with almost no interior linear detail.
